original-project-code.author: Original project code authored through Codex; exact individual attribution not independently expanded here
original-project-code.rights: Follow project rights; do not invent a new distribution license
original-project-code.runtimeDownloads: No third-party models, images, fonts, recorded audio or generated bitmap assets loaded by current game

system-font-stack.source: Installed user/browser system fonts; CSS fallback stack

original-package-vector-and-css.author: Original SVG paths and component CSS authored for this Last Ferry package
original-package-vector-and-css.rights: Retain with project sources; no new project license is asserted
original-package-vector-and-css.imports: No external icon set, raster texture or font file

supplied-concept-reference.author: Supplied generated concept references in the existing repository
supplied-concept-reference.rights: Retain existing provenance; no public-domain or new distribution-license claim

boundedExtensionRule: Update the canonical inventory in the same change that adds, replaces or retires an asset family. Instance placement belongs in level data. Do not duplicate every passenger/rock instance as an asset entry; do not invent a runtime content manager or editor.

procedural-model: semantic unit/axis/pivot convention or authoritative source
material-palette: color space and material type if applicable
allowed component roles; measured UI contrast when used for text
procedural-audio: listening evidence separate from generated-output evidence
system-font-family: whether any font file is redistributed
inline-svg-and-glyph: native button name and event owner

purpose: Audited integration seed. Current runtime sources are real; proposed UI candidates are not applied to the game yet. Resolve paths from the repository root after extracting this package.

acceptedBaseline.userFeedback: Everything seems to work great now

statusDefinitions.candidate: New editable source, awaiting actual game integration
statusDefinitions.integrated: Used and verified in the game; human acceptance is separate
statusDefinitions.retired: Kept for provenance; names its replacement
statusDefinitions.reference-only: Art direction evidence, not loaded by gameplay

entries.name: Yellow ferry with red cabin
entries.visualSignature: Curved yellow hull, warm red cabin, planked open deck, cream trim, dark fenders.
entries.reuseAndOwnership: One reusable geometry family per cove. Named deck-anchor-{passengerId} children belong to the animated hull. Shared matte materials; scoped water-contact hull material.
entries.behaviorToPreserve: Keep shaped bow, deck positions, passenger attachment, heading history and current pick/framing envelope.
